sourcePrompt: User supplied visual references covering AI agent systems, role-based programming skills, country-specific Linux distributions, frontend roadmap, Java backend journey, and full-stack production reality.
intent: Convert the supplied references into a safe SEIS development roadmap that upgrades the project from visual demo thinking into agentic, full-stack, production-aware architecture.
principles: Do not treat vibe coding as production readiness.
Every agent action must be traceable, scoped, reviewable, and reversible.
Every full-stack layer needs an explicit contract before implementation.
Local Demo mode remains safe and usable without provider keys, SSH, deployment, or external databases.
Production features advance only through validation gates, docs, and PR review.

roles.purpose: Gather repository context, docs, data, dependencies, and external references before planning.
Translate goals into milestones, risks, validation gates, and PR sequence.
Own system boundaries, layer contracts, safe escalation paths, and API/data shape.
Implement scoped changes only after contracts and guardrails are clear.
Validate quality, accuracy, security, accessibility, and rollback readiness.
Plan deployment, CI/CD, observability, scaling, and recovery without live execution until approved.
Protect secrets, auth, permissions, network boundaries, rate limits, and audit logs.
Keep UI/UX coherent, minimal, accessible, responsive, and premium.

productionStackLayers.SEISFocus: Desktop OS, Search, Code, Design, Cloud, Store, Agents, responsive shell, accessibility.
Read-only local server contracts first, then approved write APIs.
Fixture-backed JSON now; external durable storage only after schema, auth, and migration plan.
Role-based access, local demo boundary, admin/operator/contributor modes.
Static local demo first; deployment readiness report before public release.
Provider-neutral cloud plan with budget, secrets, rollback, and logs.
GitHub Actions, branch protection, check scripts, PR queue, rollback notes.
Secret redaction, provider boundary, abuse limits, RLS planning, audit logs.
Static asset optimization, offline fallback, cache policy, CDN readiness.
Documented only until server runtime and traffic assumptions exist.
Error tracking, logs, monitoring, alerts, demo evidence, health status.
Contract checks, smoke tests, browser checks, accessibility tests, security audits.
GitHub source of truth, exportable local demo state, restore plan, release tags.

learningAndImplementationTracks.SEISUse: Core tools, validators, CLIs, model-router services, desktop/server contracts.
Current browser demo, public showcase, UI systems, design/product surfaces.
Optional future backend lane; no dependency added until approved.
AI Core, RAG library, evaluation reports, knowledge graph, safe memory.
Provider boundary, MCP safety, SSH disabled-by-default policy, deployment gates.
Mythic Gacha, interactive showcases, 3D/motion creative systems.
Linux-like SEIS OS route, country-specific distro inspiration, local-first shell.
